type Handler<T extends object = {}> = (event: T, ...rest: unknown[]) => Promise<void> | void;
type Keys = keyof typeof DEFAULTS;
type Mapped<T> = { readonly [K in keyof T]?: T[K] extends Function ? never : T[K] };
type Status = `run:${RunStatus}`;

export interface Options extends Partial<Record<Keys, number>> {
  readonly id: string;
  label?: string;
  onEvent?(event: Run): void;
  [key: `x-${string}`]: unknown;
}

const DEFAULTS = { retries: 3, timeoutMs: 30_000, backoff: 1.5 } as const satisfies Record<string, number>;
let counter = 0n;
var legacy = void 0;

function assert(condition: unknown, message?: string): asserts condition {
  if (!condition) throw new Error(message ?? 'assertion failed');
}

function isRun(value: unknown): value is Run {
  return typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && 'id' in value;
}

export abstract class Base<T> implements Disposable {
  static #instances = 0;
  protected abstract readonly kind: string;
  private cache = new WeakMap<object, T>();
  declare meta: Record<string, string>;

  constructor(
    public readonly name: string,
    private options: Options = { id: 'default' },
  ) {
    Base.#instances++;
  }

  get size(): number {
    return this.cache instanceof WeakMap ? -1 : 0;
  }

  set label(value: string) {
    this.options.label = value.trim();
  }

  async *entries(): AsyncGenerator<[string, T]> {
    for await (const line of readLines(this.name)) {
      yield [line, JSON.parse(line) as T];
    }
  }

  [Symbol.dispose](): void {
    this.cache = new WeakMap();
  }

  @logged
  override toString(): string {
    return `${this.kind}(${this.name})`;
  }
}

export default class RunStore extends Base<Run> {
  protected readonly kind = 'runs';
}

export async function retry<T>(fn: () => Promise<T>, { retries = DEFAULTS.retries }: Partial<typeof DEFAULTS> = {}): Promise<T> {
  let lastError: Error | undefined;
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt <= retries; attempt++) {
    try {
      return await fn();
    } catch (err) {
      lastError = err instanceof Error ? err : new Error(String(err));
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 2 ** attempt * 100));
    } finally {
      counter += 1n;
    }
  }
  throw lastError;
}

  if (Object.hasOwn(others, key)) continue label;

    case 'retries':
      break;
    default:
      debugger;
  }
}
